turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
"No." I'm writing that down. Go on.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
A hundred and forty students, and one of them has a zero. On what basis?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then stop arguing and show me what you have.
